Name: BigGreenhouse
Author: wandanasck
Description:
[i]The size of the greenhouse increases.[/i]

Unsatisfied with the size and placement of the greenhouse iridium sprinklers I created this mod.
It increases the size of the planting area to 15x20 allowing you to place 12 sprinklers in total and slightly modifies the decor without changing the designer.
﻿
[img]http://i.imgur.com/jOb8xp0.png[/img]

[b][color=#ffff00]To use the mod without SMAPI:[/color][/b]

- Within the Stardew Valley installation folder, access the Content folder and then the Maps folder.
- Search for the Greenhouse.xnb file and rename it to Greenhouse.xnb.old, so you will have a backup file.
- Unzip and place the Content folder that was inside the rar in the installation folder of Stardew Valley.

[b]PS:[/b] Sorry for mistakes, I used Google Translate because I don't speak English.
